Repaired the implementation under `src/` while preserving the public API.

- Duplicate SKU quantities now combine.
- Items sort deterministically, independent of input order.
- Request identities are scoped to both tenant and request ID.
- Stock changes are staged on a copy, preventing partial consumption on failure.
- Stock reads no longer expose inherited properties.

Only existing production source files were modified.
